children: reported quarterly adjusted earnings of 91 cents​​ per share for the quarter ended September 30, higher than the same quarter last year, when the company reported EPS of 79 cents.  The mean expectation of fourteen analysts for the quarter was for earnings of 87 cents per share. Wall Street expected results to range from 81 cents to 92 cents per share.
Revenue rose 4.9% to $2.72 billion from a year ago; analysts expected $2.74 billion.
Alcon AG's reported EPS for the quarter was 54 cents​.
The company reported quarterly net income of $260 million.
Alcon AG shares had risen by 14.6% this quarter and lost 2.2% so far this year.
The mean earnings estimate of analysts had fallen by about 0.7% in the last three months.​
